newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel-low sulphur easier with crude.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel-low sulphur easier with crude.

text.p: Low sulphur straight run fuel was weakened on Monday by falling crude. With Brent front-month futures off 60 cents for much of the day traders reassessed low sulphur $1-2 easier.
"Its a hard market to gauge, because basically nothing is going on. The one buyer we had last week does not look interested," commented one trader.

One parcel that needs a home by Dec 20 was "getting sweaty, its been held for some time," said a dealer. Prices were pegged in the low to mid $140s fob NWE. A couple of E-4 and M-100 cargoes were around with contract business superseding spot.
